archiveImageAlt: 어두운 배경에서 기계 장치와 꽃 같은 무늬로 이루어진 두 인물이 서로 마주 앉아 생각하는 모습
Two figures made of mechanical parts and floral forms face one another in thought against a dark background
letter1: Between them lie a period and a question mark.
letter2: To me, a question is exploration, challenge, and deep listening.
letter3: 물음표를 닮은 자세로 오늘도 걸어 보렵니다.
With the posture of a question mark, I set out on my walk again today.
letter4: And here, I share the traces of that process.
